facts.note: Watches shown at the temple's nine; narrator's was exact, doctor's two minutes ahead, Girard would not take his out. Extra habit and 'what was wrong with theirs' remarks add no time.
Hall clock struck ten when the regulator showed 12 to ten; master said what he always says about it; regulator agreed exactly with the temple's ten.
Sent downstairs at regulator's 10:20; regulator running and master well; went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon, master seen in kitchen with Rosa's clock in his hands, laughing; narrator did not ask why.
'Kitchen clock', identified as Rosa's alarm clock, read 10:58 when the piano began and 11:11 when it stopped. The added make and description do not change the timepiece or the readings.
Stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
